description: This Java class implements a command handler for deleting interest rate charts in the Apache Fineract project. It processes delete commands by invoking the write platform service to delete a specific chart based on the provided entity id.

classes.name: DeleteInterestRateChartCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles delete commands for interest rate charts, integrating with the write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete command by extracting the chart entity ID and delegating the deletion to the write platform service.
